summary: DRH is a textbook honest lodging-REIT disclosure with 10 PASS tuples and zero MODERATE/SEVERE flags. Mode A verification (covenants, impairment, auditor, insider, concentration, going concern) is clean across the board. Mode B derivations — escalating covenant language, concealed concentration deterioration, cluster insider selling, counterparty mirror disclosures, recurring corporate-expense creep beyond the one-time severance — all return clean. Specifically: KPMG Big-4 auditor with no Item 4.01 events; no going-concern/substantial-doubt language; covenant headroom is wide (binding FCC covenant has ~2x cushion); 2025 mortgage maturities (~$293M) are well-covered by cash + $400M undrawn revolver (>$540M of liquidity); Westin DC City Center was honestly impaired at YE24 and sold at the marked value in Feb 2025; the 11%-concentration Chicago Marriott is the portfolio's best-performing hotel; insider selling is 100% statutory tax-withholding (zero discretionary sales); $20.4M corporate-expense jump is a quantified one-time severance tied to the April 2024 CEO transition. The -16.9% pre-cutoff drawdown looks sector-correlated (lodging-REIT macro/tariff anxiety + rate sensitivity + maturity-wall optics), not idiosyncratic concealed distress.
